changelog:
tiktok-motivation-video skill v1.0.0

- Initial release: Full pipeline to generate dark motivational TikTok/Reels videos using real video footage (no AI visuals).
- Creates script with precise timing and Pexels search keywords via Claude API.
- Generates voiceover using ElevenLabs (supports custom voice, English/Vietnamese).
- Fetches high-quality cinematic vertical videos from Pexels API.
- Composes video with animated text overlays (MoviePy) and applies color grading (FFmpeg).
- Outputs ready-to-post 1080x1920 MP4 with TikTok-compliant formatting and captions.
